SCHMITT TOWER NOTES:
====================

A SimTower created by Dave and Doug Schmitt (dschmitt@gate.net) July, 1996

A five star office building ready to turn into a TOWER the next morning.
Efficient transportation system, very high evaluation by tennants, 
and CREATED WITHOUT CHEATS.  

Now that it is complete, a few thoughts on how it might be done better
next time (these may or may not work, but might fix several annoying
messages:

	1. Since sims seem to insist on going to fast food, security 
	   and medical locations on floors below (not above), put these
	   items at the lowest escalator accessed floor below each
	   skylobby.
	2. Instead of escalators on both sides of the sky lobbies,
	   just put six floors with escalators below the sky lobbies
	   and none above.  That would allow elevators to travel
	   shorter distances, and work with #1.
	3. Start with the upper tower sections the correct width,
	   instead of layering on the outside as happened with this
	   tower.
	4. Don't make sky lobbies cross the entire floor.  Limit it
	   to the distance between the local elevators and the
	   two express elevators offering service.
	5. Adjust those express elevators a little.  While they seem
	   to work o.k. now, there is doubtless a little tweaking
	   possible to avoid the few last hot-head sims waiting
	   forever on lobby floors.
	6. Plan the sub-levels.  This basement was overextended 
	   unintentionally.
	7. Drop the rent to very-low on those lowest couple of 
	   escalator accessed floors to get "excellent" ratings
	   by the entire building.
